  <div class="home-bio">
    <h2>About</h2>
    <p>I am a second-year PhD student in Biomedical Engineering at Johns Hopkins University and a member of the <a href="https://jef.works">JEFworks Lab</a>, advised by Dr. Jean Fan. My research focuses on computational methods for spatial transcriptomics, with an emphasis on modeling cell-cell communication within tissues using data from spatial technologies such as Visium, Visium HD, MERFISH, and MERSCOPE, as well as cutting-edge technologies like Atera. Knowing which cells are communicating with one another can help explain how diseases like cancer progress and point to new drug targets. I build open-source tools so other researchers can run these analyses on their own data.</p>
